stages.next_action: Freeze S0 as passed and wait for a separate S1 implementation request.
stages.objective: Create durable context, immutable offline interfaces, a counterfactual arm registry, and fail-closed validation without market-model evaluation.
stages.pass_gate: Canonical serialization and checksums are stable; stale or invalid context fails; synthetic counterfactual ranking works; every actionable decision is no_trade; isolated modules have no runtime or external-service imports.

stages.next_action: Freeze S1 evidence and request approval before beginning S2.
stages.objective: Build the shared causal segment-aware research ledger and adapt the unchanged fixed breakout control.
stages.pass_gate: Exact 5-minute, 4-hour, and daily aggregation, point-in-time observations, breakout reproduction and BTC evidence boundaries pass without model fitting or holdout access.

stages.next_action: Freeze the EWMA control regardless of outcome before any latent-state work.
stages.objective: Evaluate a causal continuous EWMA volatility overlay that can only scale the breakout allocation downward from 10 percent.
stages.pass_gate: Fixed and scaled allocations are compared at 30, 40, and 80 bps with unchanged direction and entry timestamps.

stages.next_action: Apply the frozen conditional branch rule to S4; do not search alternative latent models.
stages.objective: Chronologically evaluate the frozen two-state Student-t HMM as a risk-only continuous exposure overlay.
stages.pass_gate: All predeclared occupancy, transition, dwell, forward-risk separation, label-stability, cost, return-retention, Calmar, tail-loss and concentration gates are reported and enforced.

stages.next_action: Continue to S5 after recording pass, rejection, or predeclared skip.
stages.objective: Conditionally evaluate one statistical jump model only if the HMM separates forward risk but fails transition or dwell stability.
stages.pass_gate: The branch is skipped when HMM passes, stopped when HMM lacks separation, or the jump model beats both EWMA and HMM under identical frozen gates.

stages.next_action: Pause unless two economically distinct strategy families are independently accepted.
stages.objective: Establish independent acceptance evidence for at least two economically distinct strategy arms.
stages.pass_gate: At least two arms from distinct families pass separate causal research programs; breakout speed variants count as one trend family.

stages.next_action: Lock the complete pipeline before any final-partition decision.
stages.objective: Evaluate counterfactual routing against single-arm, static-blend, flat and exposure-matched controls.
stages.pass_gate: Chronological shared-capital results show stable incremental net performance, transition attribution and acceptable turnover under all frozen costs while actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Require a separate mandate and explicit approval for any runtime integration or live-capital proposal.
stages.objective: Perform one locked evaluation when eligible and collect adequate prospective paper-observer evidence.
stages.pass_gate: At least 12 months, 30 filled routed trades and four risk-state transitions are observed with availability, costs, fills and decay recorded.
